item.description:

  • 日本語名: 兄貴の妻は俺の肉妻 ～夫には見せない淫らな貌を義弟に晒す巨乳若妻～
  • 英語名: Omae no Mono wa Ore no Mono Otto ni wa Misenai Midara na Kao o Otouto ni Sarasu Kyonyuu Wakazuma

あらすじ

The protagonist, Amagaya Ryouta, failed his university entrance exam and became a ronin while living with his brother and sister-in-law. Ryouta’s brother, Amagaya Shuuya, is excellent in academics and appearance, making Ryouta feel inferior. Ryouta loses motivation to study and becomes a recluse at home, with Shuuya constantly lecturing him. When Shuuya’s wife, Amagaya Honoka, offers to teach Ryouta, he resists due to his discomfort around her. However, he becomes aroused by her touch, making things worse. One day, Honoka’s behavior changes and she starts to seduce Ryouta. He suspects something is wrong but goes along with it. After discovering that Shuuya asked Honoka to sexually satisfy Ryouta, Ryouta becomes angry and contemplates stealing Honoka from him. However, he starts to question if there is more to Shuuya’s intentions and decides to investigate Honoka to uncover the truth.

item.title: NTR Kanojo wa Ijimerarekko ~Kakure Kyonyuu de Meganekko no Kanojo ga, Shiranai Aida ni ××× no ○○○ ni Sareteta Nante~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ANIM.teamMM
  • 発売日: 2011-12-16
  • スコア: 6.88/10 (83 人評価)
  • 日本語名: NTR彼女はいじめられっ娘～隠れ巨乳で眼鏡っ娘の彼女が、知らない間に×××の○○○にされてたなんて～
  • 英語名: NTR Kanojo wa Ijimerarekko Kakure Kyonyuu de Meganekko no Kanojo ga, Shiranai Aida ni ××× no ○○○ ni Sareteta Nante

あらすじ

In a certain rural school, the protagonist, Sakai Nobutaka, belonged to a class where a new transfer student, Tsukada Miki, had recently arrived. However, Miki’s family was very poor, and despite having transferred a while ago, she couldn’t even afford to buy a new uniform. This seemingly trivial matter caused her to gradually become ostracized by her classmates. At first, they just mocked her, but when rumors spread that her mother worked in the city’s red-light district, the situation changed dramatically. Some of the formerly indifferent girls began to gossip and openly ignore her. Although not many people actively participated in the bullying, none of the other classmates offered help. Nobutaka himself had traumatic experiences of being bullied in the past, so he avoided interacting with her.
